## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `develop`.
- [ ] Behaviour changes have tests that fail without the change.
- [ ] The [rules that keep existing installs working](https://github.com/maxpfingsthorn/talaria/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#rules-that-keep-existing-installs-working) still hold (configuration keys, `op` protocol and arguments, secrets, untrusted data).
- [ ] No real host names, IP addresses, accounts or tokens in code, tests or docs.
- [ ] User-facing behaviour changed? The README or AGENT_SETUP.md says so.
